description: Nate McMurray wants to hear directly from young voters like you! Come shoot some hoops, grab a hot dog, and chat with Nate. What are your concerns? A skyrocketing cost of living? Job and education opportunities? Mental health resources? Just more stuff to do around Niagara Falls? Come ask your quest
title: Hot Dogs, Hoops, and Hang with Nate McMurray — VoteNateMcMurray.com
